item.title: DRAM prices are spiking, but I don't trust the industry's why
item.description:
📝 A global surge in memory pricing Some context, first The price spike in memory (especially DRAM) is being felt worldwide. Plus, even despite those premiums, some companies report only receiving approximately 70% of the server memory that they ordered, and smaller buyers are receiving even less. Memory is being allocated to those with deeper pockets first, and it's affecting everything.
🔗 Read more: https://www.xda-developers.com/dram-prices-spiking-dont-trust-industry-reasons/
